answer: Meter exits by amount, not by account. All POA unlocking to spendable passes one network-wide queue that clears a fixed 50,000 POA per epoch, first in first out, and coins stay slashable by any audit while waiting. A farm harvesting 2,000,000 POA over 1,000 clones queues 40 epochs, about ten days at ~6 h each; splitting adds accounts, not capacity. Honest exits behind a dump wait too, the price of keeping evidence reachable. The fable of hit-and-run farming ends at an onyx gate, the loot parked in an open meadow where every auditor can see it.
